label: Which roles are you targeting?
help_text: Edit or add role titles. These guide role filtering and ranking.

label: Confirm your relevant skills
help_text: Remove incorrectly detected skills and add missing ones.

label: How many years of professional experience do you have?
help_text: Projects and education are not counted as professional employment.

label: Preferred job locations
help_text: Leave as no preference if location should not filter jobs.

label: Preferred work modes
help_text: Choose any acceptable modes.

label: Preferred employment types
help_text: Choose any acceptable employment arrangements.

label: Should location be a strict requirement?
help_text: If disabled, location is treated as a preference rather than a rejection rule.

label: Target career level
help_text: Edit the inferred level if it does not match your target.

label: Only recommend the selected roles?
help_text: Disable this for adjacent roles; selected roles still rank higher.

label: Should work mode be strict?
help_text: When enabled, remote-only never includes hybrid or on-site jobs.

label: Should employment type be strict?
help_text: When enabled, only selected employment types are eligible.

label: Exclude jobs above your experience?
help_text: When enabled, jobs requiring more professional experience are excluded.

label: Minimum acceptable annual salary
help_text: Leave empty when salary should not affect matching.

label: Salary currency
help_text: For example USD, INR, GBP, or EUR.

label: Is the minimum salary flexible?
help_text: If disabled, known salaries below the minimum are excluded.

label: What is your work authorization status?
help_text: Select the option that best describes your current status.

label: Will you need employer sponsorship now or in the future?
help_text: Saved to your profile; eligibility filtering is applied only after a job provides reliable structured sponsorship data.

label: Are you willing to relocate?
help_text: This can broaden location matches without changing your preferred locations.

label: Maximum job posting age in days
help_text: Defaults to 30 days; jobs without a reliable date remain eligible but unscored for freshness.

label: Companies to exclude
help_text: Jobs from these companies will never be recommended.
